changes: Adds Outbox 8 support and six USB audio output layouts. You pick one before adding the module, and the builder shows its routing and CPU cost.
Supports the Outbox 44.1 kHz handshake and keeps USB MIDI receive, clock and reset. USB settings are saved in backups; older ones keep the twenty-channel layout.
On the Octatrack beta base, USB Audio now syncs over USB: the Load dialog installs the base for your layout.
Documentation only: like every DRAM module it takes about 10 MB of sample memory, so a full project can show OUT OF MEMORY (#433).
Known issue: only the twenty-channel layout has run on a unit, and reports #548, #689, #718, #489 and #462 are still open.
Closes the audio stream cleanly when USB is reset or unplugged.
Reopening the stream no longer plays a tail of the previous session's audio.
Incoming USB MIDI clock now sets the tempo as well, so timestretch, LFOs and effects follow it.
Documentation only: explains that streaming starts from the computer and has no control page on the instrument. The firmware is unchanged.
Can now be built in the browser firmware builder.
First Modwerk catalog release of USB audio output for the track, main and cue streams alongside USB MIDI.
